summary_md: **Yepeng Liu ([@yepengliu](https://x.com/yepengliu/status/2115962250574057888))** summarizes the team's paper on **test-time memory evolution** ([arXiv 2610.32046](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32046), [code](https://github.com/yepengliu/TTME)), which can beat test-time training on scientific discovery with 80%+ fewer FLOPs and roughly 2× speed.
